hunks.baseline: The Bow Saint’s lips, long pressed shut, finally parted as the music drifting from beyond the distant city walls began to fade.
hunks.sol: The Bow Saint’s lips, long pressed shut, finally parted as even the music drifting from beyond the distant city walls began to fade.

hunks.baseline: I wasn’t sure.
I didn’t know whether she meant the sound of the river flowing by or the laughter carried on the breeze.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t sure what she meant—the river flowing past us, or the laughter carried on the breeze.

hunks.baseline: I could only answer with a quiet nod.
hunks.sol: I answered with a quiet nod.

hunks.baseline: “After a hard-won battle, there was always a feast like that. People would laugh and chatter until dawn, passing cups of wine back and forth without pause.”
hunks.sol: “After a hard-fought battle ended in victory, there was always a feast like that. People would laugh and chatter until dawn, passing cups of wine back and forth without pause.”

hunks.baseline: And in the scene slowly taking shape before my eyes, she must have been just as alone and apart from everyone as she was today.
hunks.sol: And in the scene slowly taking shape before my eyes, she must have been just as alone, just as apart from everyone, as she was today.

hunks.baseline: Enough time had passed for the mountains and rivers to change hands several times over, but the human heart remained the same.
hunks.sol: Enough time had passed for the mountains and rivers to change several times over, but the human heart remained the same.

hunks.baseline: Then and now, the survivors gathered together and raised their cups.
hunks.sol: Then and now, those who survived gathered together and raised their cups.

hunks.baseline: And one more for the time they had left, which might be their last.
hunks.sol: And one more for this time they had together, which might be their last.

hunks.baseline: That was why this was both a feast and a memorial service.
hunks.sol: That was why this was both a feast and a memorial rite.

hunks.baseline: I’d been staring silently at the river. Only then did I part my lips.
hunks.sol: I’d been staring silently at the river. Only then did I speak.

hunks.baseline: “The weight pressing down on my body and mind was too much to bear. I was so worried about what lay ahead that I couldn’t even let myself feel those fleeting emotions.”
hunks.sol: “The weight on my body and mind was too much to bear. I worried so much about what lay ahead that I couldn’t let myself feel even those fleeting moments.”

hunks.baseline: “And whenever that happened, someone would come over without a word and stay by my side.”
hunks.sol: “And whenever that happened, someone would come to me without a word and stay by my side.”

hunks.baseline: What I hadn’t guessed was that she’d also figured out why I’d come to see her.
hunks.sol: What I hadn’t guessed was that she’d figured out why I’d come to see her.

hunks.baseline: I took a moment to steady my breathing beneath the Bow Saint’s gaze, as if she could see straight through me.
hunks.sol: Under the Bow Saint’s gaze, which seemed to see straight through me, I took a moment to steady my breathing.

hunks.baseline: In the early days of the Great Faction War, the Demonic Cult drenched Kunlun Mountain in blood and fired the first shot of the war. As the Hundred Thousand Demonic Disciples bore down like a giant wave, the Central Plains Murim fell into utter chaos.
hunks.sol: In the early days of the Great Faction War, the Demonic Cult drenched Kunlun Mountain in blood, signaling the start of the war. As the Hundred Thousand Demonic Disciples bore down like a giant wave, the Central Plains Murim fell into utter chaos.

hunks.baseline: “Three Supreme Peak fiends, and five thousand Demonic Cultists. After suffering a crushing defeat in their first battle, the Kongtong Sect tried to retreat to Shaanxi at once, but they were caught before they could get far. The reinforcements they hastily gathered couldn’t keep up with the Demonic Cult’s speed.”
hunks.sol: “Three Supreme Peak fiends, and five thousand Demonic Cultists. After suffering a crushing defeat in its first battle, the Kongtong Sect tried to retreat to Shaanxi at once, but the enemy soon caught up. The reinforcements summoned in haste couldn’t arrive as quickly as the Demonic Cult.”

hunks.baseline: A man no one knew stood in the pursuers’ path, and a new sky opened.
hunks.sol: An unknown man stood in the pursuers’ path, and a new sky opened.

hunks.baseline: But the Huashan reinforcements, arriving late, saw everything with their own eyes.
hunks.sol: But the Huashan reinforcements, arriving late, saw the proof with their own eyes.

hunks.baseline: One of them must have felt something beyond awe: the man leading the reinforcements, the head of the Plum Blossom Swordsmen of that generation, who at barely thirty was revered as the Number One Sword Under Heaven.
hunks.sol: One of them must have felt something beyond awe: the man leading the reinforcements, the head of that generation’s Plum Blossom Swordsmen, who at barely thirty was revered as the Number One Sword Under Heaven.

hunks.baseline: “Mae Jonghak immediately spread the news to the whole realm, and before long, everyone knew: there was another supreme being who would stand against the Heavenly Demon and protect the Central Plains.”
hunks.sol: “Mae Jonghak immediately spread the news throughout the realm. Before long, everyone knew: there was another supreme being who would stand against the Heavenly Demon and protect the Central Plains.”

hunks.baseline: He united the Nine Sects and One Gang and the Five Great Families beneath the banner of the Murim Alliance, even as they repeatedly split apart and came back together. He sought no personal gain, pursuing only benevolence and righteousness.
hunks.sol: He brought the Nine Sects and One Gang and the Five Great Families, long divided and reunited by turns, together beneath the banner of the Murim Alliance. He sought no personal gain, pursuing only benevolence and righteousness.

hunks.baseline: “I watched it all from close by. Again and again, I marveled at the string of achievements beyond words. There were those who dared to envy him, resent him, and doubt him, but before long, even they came to admire the Martial God deeply.”
hunks.sol: “I watched it all from close by. Again and again, I marveled at his achievements, too great to put into words. There were those who dared to envy, resent, and doubt him, but before long, even they came to admire the Martial God deeply.”

hunks.baseline: In the pitch-black night, the stars glittered like her title, though beside the vast heavens above they were little more than tiny lights.
hunks.sol: In the pitch-black night, stars glittered, echoing her title. But beside the vast heavens above, they were no more than tiny lights.

hunks.baseline: “Those who lived in the same era as me know. The Martial God was truly a miraculous being. No one under Heaven could ever accomplish what he did.”
hunks.sol: “Those who lived in my time know. The Martial God was truly a miracle, and no one under Heaven could ever accomplish what he did.”

hunks.baseline: When her long story ended, silence settled. I’d been looking at her without a word when I suddenly parted my lips.
hunks.sol: When her long story ended, silence settled. I watched her for a moment, then spoke.

hunks.baseline: The Bow Saint’s gaze, fixed on the sky, slid slowly toward me.
hunks.sol: The Bow Saint’s gaze slid slowly down from the sky to me.

hunks.baseline: Her answer came back just a little too late.
hunks.sol: Her answer came a fraction too late.

hunks.baseline: For an instant, I thought her eyes had wavered ever so slightly. Was that just my imagination, or had I mistaken the river reflected in them for a flicker in her gaze?
hunks.sol: For an instant, I thought her eyes had wavered. Was that just my imagination, or had I mistaken the river reflected in them for a flicker in her gaze?

hunks.baseline: I hid the question rising in my mind and spoke again.
hunks.sol: I kept the question to myself and spoke again.

hunks.baseline: “How could I tell you everything about more than a decade in such a short time? Besides, there are plenty of people who remember what he did. Even if I stayed a little closer to him, that wouldn’t change.”
hunks.sol: “How could I tell you everything about more than a decade in so short a time? Besides, plenty of people remember what he did. Staying a little closer to him would hardly make my account different.”

hunks.baseline: Her voice was as calm as ever, despite the brief flicker of agitation she’d shown a moment earlier.
hunks.sol: Despite that fleeting hint of agitation, her voice was as calm as ever.

hunks.baseline: “The same goes for the letter. In keeping with his final wish, I spent many years searching for the ‘chosen one.’ That’s why we’re here together now.”
hunks.sol: “The same goes for the letter. In keeping with his final wish, I spent many years searching for the ‘chosen one.’ That is why we stand here together now.”

hunks.baseline: The Bow Saint’s words were borne out by the fact that she’d spent decades wandering all over the realm.
hunks.sol: The Bow Saint had spent decades wandering the realm. Her own life bore out her words.

hunks.baseline: And I knew that the woman before me had walked a difficult path as a chivalrous warrior—one I wasn’t qualified to judge.
hunks.sol: And I knew the woman before me was a chivalrous warrior who had walked a harder path than I could presume to judge.

hunks.baseline: But I thought her answer was both completely true and incomplete.
hunks.sol: But to my mind, her answer was both entirely true and incomplete.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t a passing guess. It was a conclusion drawn from instinct and cold reason.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t a passing guess. Instinct and cold reason had brought me to the same conclusion.

hunks.baseline: For all the times we’d shared life and death, short as it had been, the Bow Saint had repeatedly refused to join the rest of our group.
hunks.sol: We hadn’t known each other long, but we’d faced life and death together many times. Even so, the Bow Saint had repeatedly kept herself apart from the rest of us.

hunks.baseline: I remembered the story the Slaughter Saint had cautiously told me the night before, when he came to see me alone.
hunks.sol: I remembered what the Slaughter Saint had cautiously told me the night before, when he came to see me alone.

hunks.baseline: I’d already turned the question over in my mind more times than I could count. It didn’t even need thinking through.
hunks.sol: I’d already turned the question over in my mind several times. It didn’t even need thinking through.

hunks.baseline: Whether I’d moved on instinct or reason.
hunks.sol: Whether I acted on instinct or reason.

hunks.baseline: On the day of the great battle surrounding Xining, she’d told the Slaughter Saint, who wanted to save me, that if Jin Taekyung died that day, then it was fate.
hunks.sol: On the day of the great battle around Xining, she’d told the Slaughter Saint, who wanted to save me, that if Jin Taekyung died that day, then it was fate.

hunks.baseline: When countless people were dying in every direction, how could one life matter more than another?
hunks.sol: With countless people dying on every side, how could one life matter more than another?

hunks.baseline: But why had the Bow Saint, who’d spent decades searching for the “chosen one” based on nothing but an old letter supposedly left by the Martial God, been so indifferent to my death?
hunks.sol: But why had the Bow Saint, who’d spent decades searching for the “chosen one” on the strength of an old letter supposedly left by the Martial God, been so indifferent to my death?

hunks.baseline: Just as I drew in a sharp breath—
hunks.sol: As I swallowed a breath—

hunks.baseline: A surge of river water rushed up and touched my toes.
hunks.sol: River water surged up and touched my toes.

hunks.baseline: The cold seeped through my leather shoes. Snapping out of my deep thoughts, I instinctively stepped back.
hunks.sol: Cold seeped into my leather shoes. Snapped out of my thoughts, I instinctively stepped back.

hunks.baseline: Then I met a pair of eyes watching me intently.
hunks.sol: Then I met the Bow Saint’s watchful eyes.

hunks.baseline: The Bow Saint gave a small nod, and I continued, my voice already trembling.
hunks.sol: She gave a small nod, and I continued, my voice trembling now.
